Subject: Engagement sprint manifest & POC onboarding action plan

Hi Sam / Priya — great running through the discovery with you today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before we kick the POC off.

Key pain points we heard
- Latency spikes on inference at 99th percentile when batched requests hit > 16 tokens (user search flows).
- High per-request unit cost on existing provider; need predictable unit economics for 100k daily queries.
- Observability gap: no token-level traces to correlate regressions to prompt changes.

Primary goals for the 30-day POC
1) Validate a 2x cost reduction per 1k tokens with model/quantization + batching config while keeping median latency < 120ms.
2) Build an eval suite (50 sample prompts + edge-case prompts) to detect quality regression against baseline.
3) Demonstrate stable 95th/99th latency under a 200 RPS synthetic load with our autoscale profile.

Scope & success metrics (draft) attached — see Novaline_MVP_success_metrics.xlsx. High-level items:
- Model: open-checkpoint gpt-small-8k-quant (we'll recommend right-size after token distribution analysis).
- Ownership: Novaline to provide sample prompt set + representative traffic capture (anonymized); Redwood will provide eval harness and a configuration recommended for Dedicated or Hosted.
- Timeline: access + sample data by Mon 29 Jun -> quick config/setup (3 days) -> internal run (week of Jul 6) -> evaluation and readout Jul 13.

Immediate asks for onboarding (we put these in the attached checklist):
- Add redwood-onboard@novaline.ai to your IDP or provide SAML metadata for SSO.
- Provision one S3 bucket (read-only) with a representative CSV of user queries + labels; redacted PII only.
- Point us to the security contact for the SOC2 / privacy questionnaire (we'll push the questionnaire first thing).

Proposed kickoff (tentative): Wed Jul 7, 10:00-11:00 PT — tech owners and product manager from Novaline + Laura (ops) + me. If that works we'll send an invite and a short agenda.

Thanks — I captured owners and actions in the attached onboarding checklist. I’ll follow up with the HubSpot mutual action plan once we lock the kickoff.

Best,
Ben

- Security: contracts@novaline.ai will own the SOC2 questionnaire; I’ve cc’d the mailbox for visibility. Expect an initial questionnaire response by Jul 2.

On the cost objective — our procurement team needs a ballpark commitment on maximum spend for the POC (monthly) to preapprove a short-term credit card. Ballpark estimate that Francisco (procurement) needs: what’s the expected monthly burn for a 30-day POC at 200 RPS synthetic run?

FWIW — we run with Postgres-backed search and will likely route requests through a caching layer; we're most interested in proving the inference cost + latency improvements on the critical search path.

Appreciate the checklist attachment. I'll confirm owners by Friday and get SAML metadata to you if we go the SSO route.
